view: Palmyra surviving weathered limestone colonnade from diagonal low angle, several upright columns receding across sandy ground with broken drums in foreground and oasis palms distant. No intact triumphal arch, no intact Temple of Bel, no modern conflict or vehicles.

eras.title: Columns at the oasis
eras.caption: Palmyra's colonnaded street crossed a city enriched by caravan trade. Rows of limestone columns still explain its plan: a Roman-style avenue set beside an oasis, on routes linking the Mediterranean with lands farther east.
